scope: Abstract capture/loss/reacquisition/check transition. Existing-lock observation refuses unavailable guards, including loss without reacquisition. Same native transaction ID does not entail guard retention. Loss/reacquisition admits release with no uninterrupted original cut.
limitations: No native PostgreSQL lock/transaction, host lease, SQL, JSON or UMF refinement proof
No-loss is a premise under the exclusive host/raw-alias contract, not proved by endpoint observations
No authenticated issuer/mapping/target/credential, complete source/role/ACL lifetime or protected final-release qualification
